newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SPT shares jump, boost PX50 index 5.1 pts to 507.5.
newsitem.headline: SPT shares jump, boost PX50 index 5.1 pts to 507.5.

text.p: Strong gains to SPT Telecom helped push the Prague Stock Exchange's PX50 index higher on Tuesday, offsetting market fears that damages from heavy flooding could bite hard into corporate results.
SPT rose 177 crowns to 3,6557 as the PX50 index closed up 5.1 points, or 1.02 percent, at 507.5.

The rise came after SPT said in a statement that it was still too early to "calculate any financial sums" as a result of the flooding, but that the lines affected represent only three percent of SPT's total lines in operation.
But traders said the rise came on a late deal, and was not indicative of an uptrend in the issue.

Analysts said overall investor sentiment, weak to begin with, has fallen even further given estimates that damage from heavy flooding recently may total as much as 100 billion crowns, and could cost the already sluggish economy up to one full percentage point in GDP growth this year.

"We're seeing some of the construction companies going up, but the companies that were hit by the floods are going down. (Insurer) Ceska Pojistovna for example has traded off quite significantly," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company.
Poijstovna, which has estimated claims of its customers will reach five billion crowns, fell 35 crowns to 2,501. Pojistovna shares have fallen about 300 crowns in the last month.
Overall on the bourse, decliners narrowly led advancers by 103 to 99, with 47 issues holding steady. Total volume was modest at 539,548 shares on turnover of 614.2 million crowns.
